strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets a scheduled controller derive the next Product DoD gap from runtime-owned evidence instead of supplying remaining_capability text itself.
Requires explicit product evidence derivation and completion decision authorization, fresh artifact hashes, bounded policy metadata, and derived matrix fingerprints before ledger mutation.
Surfaces bounded selected remaining gap metadata, next action, and SHA-256 fingerprints so a headless caller can continue without raw content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with runtime_permission_enforcement and progress_visualization support.
answers.new_capability: headless.run.drive derives one prioritized open required Product DoD gap from a project completion policy, commits it into the product evidence matrix, and lets product_completion_decision continue from that runtime-selected gap without caller-supplied remaining_capability.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M52.2 derives category/count/claim evidence from policy artifacts, and M61 derives/admits continuation objectives, but the controller still had to author the specific remaining product gap outside Rust authority.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: The autonomous loop can know a product is incomplete but cannot select the next required Product DoD gap under replay-safe runtime evidence, leaving continuation planning dependent on external text.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M52.2 generic product evidence and M61 continuation admission because this phase selects and enforces a remaining Product DoD gap inside the existing product evidence matrix and decision path.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.run.drive product_evidence_derivation and product_completion_decision envelopes are extended; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The selected gap is bounded runtime result metadata, not a report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, verdict, or summary wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime now rejects incomplete product policies without one open required Product DoD gap, fingerprints the selected gap into the derived matrix, denies product_complete while such a gap is open, and derives remaining_capability for continue_development from the selected gap.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A scheduled controller can proceed from product evidence to the next Product DoD work item using Rust-selected bounded metadata, reducing caller-authored continuation decisions.
answers.milestone_progress: Starts M62 by closing the gap between product evidence matrices and Product Charter DoD convergence; later M62 phases can use this selected gap as the source for concrete continuation tasks.

reject_when: Product DoD gap selected by caller-authored remaining_capability instead of the runtime-derived matrix
missing behavior tests for selected-gap continuation and malformed-gap denial
automatic provider, tool, shell, git, network, service, or workspace mutation

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: Manifest updates select the current M62.1 value gate; no guard engine logic is changed.

exit_criteria: headless.run.drive product_evidence_derivation accepts a project completion policy with product_dod_remaining_gaps
runtime validates gap shape, status, required flag, numeric priority, next action, and duplicate IDs before matrix ledger mutation
runtime selects one open required gap deterministically and fingerprints it into the product evidence matrix
product_completion_decision can omit remaining_capability when consuming a derived matrix with a selected gap
decision result exposes the runtime-selected remaining capability and selected gap fingerprint
product_complete is denied before ledger mutation while the derived matrix contains an open required Product DoD gap
malformed Product DoD gap evidence is rejected without appending HeadlessRunProductEvidenceMatrixDerived
no new JSON-RPC method, wrapper, report, readiness, preview, digest, history, verdict, shell/git/network/service action, or workspace mutation is added
behavior_evidence: Behavior test headless_run_drive_selects_remaining_product_dod_gap_and_decides validates derived gap selection, selected-gap fingerprinting, caller-omitted remaining_capability, decision replay, and bounded no-raw-content output.
Behavior test headless_run_drive_rejects_stale_or_malformed_remaining_gap_selection validates malformed gap denial before product evidence matrix ledger mutation.
VSIX runtimeClient tests validate selected_remaining_gap shape on product evidence matrices and product completion decisions while rejecting malformed fingerprints and statuses.

accepted_capability: headless.run.drive derives a Product DoD remaining gap from runtime-validated project completion policy evidence.
product_completion_decision can continue development from that selected gap without caller-supplied remaining_capability.
behavior_evidence: Rust tests cover selected-gap continuation and malformed-gap denial.
VSIX tests cover bounded protocol validation for selected gap metadata.
safety_boundary: Requires explicit product evidence derivation and completion decision authorization.
Rejects unsafe, stale, malformed, duplicate, or incomplete policy evidence before ledger mutation.
Does not expose raw policy, evidence artifact, prompt, provider, stdout, stderr, command, environment, path, or secret content.
Does not run providers, tools, shell, git, network, services, or workspace mutation.
non_goals: Does not add a new JSON-RPC method or wrapper surface.
Does not create, delete, or mutate workspace files.
Does not auto-plan, auto-run, or auto-merge future phases.
Does not decide milestone completion solely from selected gap metadata.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected a product completion gap report because it would not change continuation behavior.
Rejected caller-authored remaining_capability as the primary source because it keeps Product DoD selection outside Rust authority.
Rejected a broad Product Charter parser because one bounded project policy gap list is enough for this phase.
technical_debt: The selected gap is a bounded policy-declared item; future phases can connect it directly to runtime-derived continuation task creation.
The initial selection rule is deterministic highest numeric priority then gap_id rather than a semantic ranking engine.
next_capability_rationale: Next M62 work should bind selected Product DoD gap metadata into runtime-derived continuation task admission, not add another inspection surface.
